evidence.name: Screen field: Style the purchase button label
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the purchase button label" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the purchase button label
sections.description: Controls the look of the text inside the purchase button — font, size, weight, color, alignment, and spacing — not the button box itself, which you style under 'Style purchase button box and appearance'. This is your main call-to-action, so make the label large, bold, and high-contrast against the button fill. Weak or hard-to-read button text directly costs you taps and sales.
